== Summary ==
No one is named in the source.

== Description ==

The top three pairings of each game played on the stage. At the [[2002 Bespin Regionals]], Coach's Corner, Apache Plaza Mall, St. Anthony, Minnesota, 15 June 2002.

== Source and credit ==

Published on the MNSWCCG website's "2002 Bespin Regional Weekend Pictures" page: [http://www.mnswccg.com/bespin_regional/2002_Bespin_Regional_Pictures.html mnswccg.com/bespin_regional/2002_Bespin_Regional_Pictures.html]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20021102035753/http://www.mnswccg.com/bespin_regional/2002_Bespin_Regional_Pictures.html Internet Archive]. The page does not say who took the pictures; [[Nick Kolnik]], who ran the site, directed the event.

* '''Source caption:''' "The first three pairings each game are on the stage"
* '''Original image:''' http://www.mnswccg.com/bespin_regional/2002_weekend_pictures/IM000666.JPG. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20021113112021/http://www.mnswccg.com:80/bespin_regional/2002_weekend_pictures/IM000666.JPG Internet Archive]
* '''Date photographed:''' 15 June 2002
